name: UK energy price cap
summary: Forecasts put the January cap 26–28% above today's £1,723 a year; Ofgem is due to announce by 25 Nov
state: The cap for a typical dual-fuel household is £1,723 a year from 1 Oct. Supplier forecasts averaged by Uswitch point to a rise of about 28% in January, and Cornwall Insight's latest forecast is a rise of about 26% (Uswitch, 6 Nov; IBTimes). Both are above the 20% Alert line. Ofgem is due to announce the January to March 2027 cap on or before 25 Nov, which will replace the forecasts.
for_you: Households on standard variable tariffs face notably higher bills from 1 Jan if forecasts hold. People struggling with bills can find official help on Ofgem's and the government's energy support pages.
rubric_hit: Alert: forecast January cap rise about 26–28% ≥ 20% Alert line
